auth.register.biometricPrompt: Ihe nchọgharị gị ga-arịọ maka nkwenye biometric

landing.heroDesc: Mgbakọ nchekwa ego anaghị akwụ ụgwọ na Stellar. Ndị na-emekọrịta ihe efu. Ọchịchị ego maka ijeri 1.3 enweghị ụlọ akụ.
landing.feat1Title: Enweghị ntụkwasị obi & N'ụzọ doro anya
landing.feat1Desc: Nkwekọrịta smart na-akwado iwu ọ bụla. Ọ dịghị onye nhazi nwere ike iji ọdọ mmiri gbapụ. A kwadoro nkwado ọ bụla n'agbụ.
landing.feat2Desc: Onye ọ bụla nwere obere akpa Stellar. Enweghị akaụntụ akụ. Enweghị nlele kredit. Enweghị oke.
landing.feat3Desc: Jiri ntinye oge ọ bụla wulite MoiScore gị. Njirimara ego enwere ike ibugharị.
landing.feat4Desc: Azụmahịa obere centi stellar na-eme okirikiri kwa ụbọchị bara uru. Enweghị ụgwọ ikpo okwu imepụta ma ọ bụ sonye.
landing.feat5Desc: Rand, edobere, ọrịre ahịa ma ọ bụ votu. Gburugburu gị, iwu gị.
landing.feat6Desc: USDC taa. More stablecoins na map okporo ụzọ.
landing.readyDesc: Mepụta okirikiri nchekwa mbụ gị n'ihe na-erughị nkeji abụọ.
